title: Roadmap structure lists the newest tickets first
description: The Structure view of the roadmap lists tickets oldest first (PLAN-1 at the top). Owner wants newest first; the order of children under a parent follows the same rule.

outcome.summary: Roadmap structure lists the newest tickets first at every level; the order of children follows the same rule.
